source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    centers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 3)]
    arms = {}
    for r, c, color in centers:
        arms[(r, c)] = {(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)}
    ownership = {}
    for pos, cells in arms.items():
        for cell in cells:
            ownership.setdefault(cell, set()).add(pos)
    empty_cross_cols = set()
    for r in range(1, h-1):
        for c in range(1, w-1):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 and all(grid[y][x] == 3 for y,x in
                    ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))):
                empty_cross_cols.add(c)
    # Vertical projections are laid down first, so they win at crossings.
    for r, c, color in centers:
        for step in (-1, 1):
            y = r + step
            while 0 <= y < h:
                if grid[y][c] == 3 and (y,c) not in arms[(r,c)]:
                    break
                if out[y][c] == 0:
                    out[y][c] = color
                y += step
    for r, c, color in centers:
        for step in (-1, 1):
            x = c + step
            while 0 <= x < w:
                if grid[r][x] == 3 and (r,x) not in arms[(r,c)]:
                    break
                if x not in empty_cross_cols and out[r][x] == 0:
                    out[r][x] = color
                x += step
    return out
'''
